source_quality.notes: Five pages carry no text layer.

task_reconstruction.summary: Forecast the 2028 medal table with intervals and name risers and decliners.
Estimate which countries win a first medal and how many.
Score the sports that matter and the effect of a host's event choices.
Quantify the great coach effect and spend it on three countries.

contributions.summary: A weighted fusion gives the United States 143 medals and China 76.
Three countries are the most likely first-time medalists.
Three different coach coefficients all scale to a contribution of 1.7.

dependency_graph.summary: The regression and the network feed the combined forecast.
The combined forecast feeds the bootstrap interval.
The coach contribution of 1.7 is reused on three countries.

assumptions.summary: Only the 2016, 2020, and 2024 Games are used.
Debutants match athletes who will not return.
Russia and Belarus are left out of the 2028 table.
The 2028 Games face no major disruption.
Medals are analyzed at the sport level.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Names, codes, and merged sports are standardized in one table.
Countries with at least one medal are removed to leave the debutants.

models.summary: The linear regression uses four features.
The two models are weighted by each other's error.
The logistic model and the forest score a first medal.
Four indicators form the importance score.
The breakpoint regression measures the coach.

verification.summary: RMSE is 2.667 and MAPE is 51.099 percent.
Five hundred bootstrap draws give the interval.
The Monte Carlo mode agrees with the count of three.

results_trace.summary: America gains 17 medals and France drops after hosting.
Swimming scores 39.8 for the United States and diving 33.1 for China.
Poland, Nigeria, and India are named for a coach.

writing_logic.summary: The summary names the consequence before any formula.
Each model is praised and then charged with a limit.
The extra finding is labeled as other insights.

language_observations.summary: Five past-tense verbs share one subject in the opening.
Each assumption ends with a reason introduced by ensuring or indicating.
The core principal here is announces a design rule.

visualization_observations.summary: Figure 1, the Sankey of medal flow.
Figure 6, medal share beside medal counts.
Figure 7, mean and variance of first medals.
Figure 8, the count of first-time medal countries.
Figure 9, the Monte Carlo of first medals.
Figure 12, the United States around the coach.
Figure 20, the competitiveness index against medals.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: A judge can check the headline numbers against the table.
A judge can test whether three different coefficients can share one ratio.

weaknesses.summary: The host spillover is left out of the forecast model.
Some formulas were chosen without calculation.

independent_extensions.summary: The host effect could be split into a home term and a neighbor term.

unresolved_questions: The summary says MLP where the body says MLR.
The summary pairs Keiko Kageyama with China and Dave Brailsford with the UK, while the body credits Keiko Kageyama to both the UK and China.
The contribution printed is 0.3 over D_USA, 6.9 over D_UK, and 1.3 over D_CHN, and each is said to equal 1.7.
The odds table prints 4:1 beside an 80 percent chance and 16:1 beside a 94 percent chance.
The cross-validation accuracies 88.09 and 94.12 are called both probabilities and odds.
Page 23 has no text layer and was not visually reviewed.
Reference 2 prints [First Name] for the second author.
The body prints the core principal here is and may due to and results from these maps 17.
The caption of Table 3 says 2024 while the forecast is for 2028.
The United States total interval is printed as 110 to 192 in the table and 116 to 193 in the prose.
